The Gradle Wrapper JAR will be downloaded automatically by the wrapper into:
  gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar

Use the root wrapper bridge or the Android workspace wrapper to build:

From repository root:
  ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug

From Android workspace root:
  cd content-rating-display-213568/vod_content_rating_frontend
  ./gradlew :app:assembleDebug
